purpose: Freeze the verified Banner Stage 1 information units, invariants, correction requirements, and explicit REVIEW/UNKNOWN boundaries so Stage 2 can design the production canonical schema without reopening already-settled investigation questions.

frozenPopulation.rowGrainMeaning: One Korean schedule row represents one dated/display-position banner occurrence item. It is not a canonical banner definition row.
frozenPopulation.recordKeyRole: Occurrence row key only; not canonical banner definition identity.

frozenInformationUnits.meaning: A dated Korean schedule/display occurrence with per-date presentation order, lifecycle/display behavior, source relation when available, and occurrence-level display-asset reference.
ConfigDataCardPoolInfo source identity reached through sourceRecordKey when available.
Stage 1 evidence requires Stage 2 to model recurring banner/source concept separately from individual dated occurrences; final table/key design is intentionally not frozen in Stage 1.
CP_RELATED is a context relation/tag derived from explicit CardPool source text, not a mutually exclusive summon mechanic.
CP CardPool text can name an event, but canonical Event ID relation is not proven.
displayImageType/displayImageFile are occurrence-level display references, not canonical banner or asset identities.

frozenTaxonomy.latestClarification: CP_RELATED was reserved for review in Stage 1-3 and was subsequently verified in Stage 1-4 as a non-exclusive context relation derived only from explicit CardPool source semantics.
frozenTaxonomy.sourceTypePolicy: sourceType remains source classification evidence and must not be overwritten by occurrence taxonomy.

wishCandidateHero.rule: Preserve sourceField provenance; use HeroId as Hero identity; do not merge wish candidates into PICKUP_HERO semantics.

manualWish.rule: When sourceRecordKey is null, do not synthesize CardPool, Hero candidate, or recurrence identity from display text, names, or asset reuse.

cpRelated.rule: Assign only from explicit CardPoolDetailDesc CP-point semantics.

krDisplayDate.meaning: Occurrence display-date anchor in the Korean schedule

frozenDateAndRecurrence.displayOrder: Presentation order within one krDisplayDate only; not chronology.
frozenDateAndRecurrence.recurrenceRule: Repeated dated occurrences may reuse the same verified/corrected source identity. Store observed occurrences; do not generate recurrence from a fixed cadence.
frozenDateAndRecurrence.firstObservedBoundary: Earliest occurrence inside the 94-row current window is not automatically first-ever release.

rules: displayImageFile is not canonical bannerId or assetId.
Same verified source may reuse the same asset reference across multiple occurrence dates.
Same asset reference alone must not establish source or recurrence identity.
manual-replacement is a provenance/status distinction and is not equivalent to missing image.
visualType=prefab does not mean the website lacks a static display image.

mandatoryCorrectionCheckpoint.rule: Apply the correction checkpoint before definition grouping, recurrence grouping, Hero relation consumption, or production consumer generation, unless an explicit later repair step updates the source schedule itself.

prohibitedInferencesFrozen: No chronology from CardPool ID, bannerCode, patchCode, slotCode, Hero ID, asset filename, or file order.
No canonical banner identity from bannerCode, sourceRecordKey, recordKey, or displayImageFile alone.
No endDate/duration inference from the next schedule date or assumed banner duration.
No fixed recurrence generation from observed gaps.
No source/recurrence join from asset equality alone.
No Hero candidate synthesis for source-null manual wish rows.
No forced classification when evidence is insufficient; REVIEW/UNKNOWN remain valid.

carriedReviewAndUnknown.item: Canonical Event ID relation for CP/banner+event consumers
carriedReviewAndUnknown.resolutionTarget: Stage 2 relation/schema work or a dedicated Event-ID verification subtask

carriedReviewAndUnknown.item: Canonical CardPool/Hero candidate/recurrence identity for source-null manual wish rows
carriedReviewAndUnknown.resolutionTarget: Stage 2 manual-definition policy or an approved manual ID map

carriedReviewAndUnknown.item: Exact banner opening/closing timestamp, timezone semantics, endDate and duration
carriedReviewAndUnknown.resolutionTarget: Later authoritative schedule/time source if available

carriedReviewAndUnknown.item: Canonical asset identity/ownership and hash/visual duplicate groups
Canonical first-ever release date outside current 94-row schedule window
carriedReviewAndUnknown.resolutionTarget: Later history-source work if required by consumers

carriedReviewAndUnknown.item: Final production bannerDefinition/bannerOccurrence schema and canonical IDs

mustPreserve: Occurrence identity distinct from source/definition identity
0..1 source relation per occurrence with legitimate source-null manual rows
Exact-ID Hero relations and distinct pickup vs wish-candidate semantics
CP_RELATED as non-exclusive context and Event ID as unresolved until proven
Day-precision occurrence date semantics without invented end/duration
Occurrence-level asset references without treating filenames as canonical identity
stage2MayDecide: Canonical bannerDefinition and bannerOccurrence primary keys/IDs
Final normalized tables/objects and field names
How the provisional taxonomy axes are represented in production
Manual banner definition policy and approved manual IDs if needed
Whether explicit Event ID mapping can be proven without name-only joins

nextStartPoint.task: Canonical banner identity and production schema design
nextStartPoint.firstObjective: Define bannerDefinition/bannerOccurrence canonical identities and normalized relation fields while preserving every Stage 1 frozen invariant and REVIEW boundary.
